slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
“还有三个月就是授箓大典......”
“以我现在的修为境界，回了茅山别说受箓神职，不给师父丢人就不错了。”
义庄后院，苏辰盘膝坐在蒲团上，目光扫过周围熟悉的环境，面露复杂之色。
他不是这个世界的人。
十八年前，他从地球穿过来，睁眼时就成了个襁褓里的婴儿。
那一年兵荒马乱，野地里阴气重，荒坟边哭声比狗叫都多。
好在他命还算硬，被外出办事的九叔捡了回来，抱进义庄，一口米汤一口药吊着，硬是养大了。
这些年，他跟着九叔修道认字，画符踩罡，练吐纳，学规矩，每一样都下足了功夫！
但奈何境界提升缓慢，这么多年修炼下来，堪堪道士初期。
其实力虽然比起秋生文才要强上许多，但放到茅山那群正经弟子里，他这点修为不过是路边一条。
真到了授箓那天，台下站着一群同门，台上却被人一掌轰下来，摔得灰头土脸......
那丢的就不是他一个人的脸了，是师父林九的脸！
一想到这里，苏辰胸口就堵得慌。
而就在这时，一道声音自前院飘了过来
“文才，后院那只报晓雄鸡越长越好了！咱们什么时候把它炖着吃了，肯定倍儿香！”
说话的是秋生，语气中满是对吃肉的渴望，吐字间还夹杂着吞咽口水的声音。
“你疯了？！”文才压抑的声音响起，带着一丝恐惧，“那鸡是师父留着取血画符的！你敢吃它，师父回来得把你腿打断！”
“胆小鬼！”
秋生哼了一声，声音都拔高了几分。
“谁说我要偷鸡？咱们这是替师父分忧。画符缺鸡血，先放点血，鸡肉顺手下锅，这叫一鸡两用。回头师父问起来，就说最近邪祟多，符画得勤，鸡血用得快。”

文才听得倒抽凉气：“这种话你自己去说，我不陪你挨打。”
“你瞧你那点出息。”
“我这是惜命！”
苏辰听着听着，嘴角都扯了一下，想笑，又笑不出来。
他这两个师弟，还是老样子。
秋生嘴碎，胆子时大时小，遇着热闹就往前拱。
文才能偷懒的时候绝不多迈一步，见了鬼跑得比谁都快，不过心眼不坏。
茅山授箓这种事，在他们俩耳朵里远没有一锅鸡肉来得实在。
苏辰吐出一口浊气，抬手抹了把脸。
指望他们两个上进，不如指望院里那只大公鸡自己学会画符。
“算了，还是靠我自己吧......”
苏辰把心思压下去，重新闭上眼。
五心朝天，舌抵上腭，继续运转功法。
空气里的灵气一点点朝他身上聚来，像水丝钻进毛孔，沿经络慢慢往丹田里沉。
然而，下一秒，他的丹田像是开了个大洞一般！
刚刚修炼来的灵气连同自身的灵力，一股脑的从那个“洞”中泄露而去。
苏辰眼皮一跳，霍然睁眼，后背瞬间被冷汗打湿，“什么东西？！我的灵力呢？？”
还没等他考虑什么，一道冰冷清晰的声音，在他脑海深处炸开。

content_en:
"There are three months until the enshrinement ceremony..."
"With my current level of cultivation, it would be good if I don't embarrass my master when I return to Maoshan, let alone accept the priesthood."
In the backyard of Yizhuang, Su Chen sat cross-legged on a futon, looking at the familiar surroundings with a complicated look on his face.
He is not of this world.
Eighteen years ago, he passed through the earth and became a swaddled baby when he opened his eyes.
That year there was chaos and war, the fields were filled with gloomy air, and there were more cries than dogs barking beside the graves.
Fortunately, his life was still strong, and he was picked up by Uncle Jiu who was out on business. He was carried into Yizhuang and raised with a mouthful of rice soup and a mouthful of medicine.
Over the years, he followed Uncle Jiu to practice Taoism, read calligraphy, draw talismans and step on the Gang, practice breathing, and learn rules, and he put in a lot of effort in everything!
However, the level of improvement is slow. After so many years of practice, he is comparable to the early stage of a Taoist priest.
Although his strength is much stronger than that of Qiu Shengwencai, among the group of serious disciples in Maoshan, his cultivation level is just a passing one.
On the day of the enshrinement, there were a group of fellow disciples standing in the audience, but someone on the stage knocked him down with a palm, and he was thrown into disgrace...
It wasn't just his face that was being shamed, it was Master Lin Jiu's face!
Su Chen's chest felt clogged when he thought of this.
At this moment, a voice floated over from the front yard
"Wencai, that dawn rooster in the backyard is getting better and better! Let's stew it and eat it. It will definitely be delicious!"
It was Qiu Sheng who spoke, his tone full of desire for meat, and the sound of swallowing saliva mixed with his words.
"Are you crazy?!" Wencai's suppressed voice sounded, with a hint of fear, "That chicken was kept by the master to draw the blood drawing talisman! If you dare to eat it, the master will break your legs when he comes back!"
"Coward!"
Qiu Sheng snorted, his voice rising a little higher.
"Who said I wanted to steal a chicken? We are here to share Master's worries. There is a lack of chicken blood in drawing the talisman. Let's put some blood first and the chicken will be put into the pot. This is called a chicken with two uses. When Master asked later, he said that there have been many evil spirits recently. If you draw the talisman frequently, the chicken blood will be used up quickly."
Wencai gasped when he heard this: "You can say this yourself, I won't accompany you to get beaten."
"Look at your potential."
"I cherish my life!"
As Su Chen listened, the corners of his mouth twitched. He wanted to laugh, but couldn't.
His two junior brothers are still the same.
Qiu Sheng is short-tongued, his courage sometimes gets bigger and smaller, and he pushes forward when there is excitement.
Wen Cai never takes more than one step when he is lazy. He will run faster than anyone else when he sees a ghost, but he has a good heart.
To both of them, Maoshan's education was far less real than a pot of chicken.
Su Chen exhaled a breath and raised his hand to wipe his face.
It is better to expect the two of them to make progress than to expect the big rooster in the yard to learn how to draw talismans on his own.
"Forget it, I'll just rely on myself..."
Su Chen suppressed his thoughts and closed his eyes again.
With your five hearts facing the sky, your tongue touching the roof of your mouth, continue to perform the exercise.
The spiritual energy in the air gathered on him bit by bit, like water threads drilling into his pores, slowly sinking into his Dantian along his meridians.
However, the next second, his Dantian seemed to have a big hole!
The spiritual energy he had just cultivated, together with his own spiritual power, all leaked out of the "hole".
Su Chen's eyelids twitched, and he suddenly opened his eyes. His back was instantly wet with cold sweat, "What?! Where is my spiritual power?"
Before he could think about anything, a cold and clear voice exploded in the depths of his mind.
